name: Accordion
description: A stack of sections, each a button that shows or hides its body. Open sections can stay open together, and a flush accordion drops the outer border and radius.
sources: Arizona Bootstrap 5.2.0's compiled CSS, as az-digital/design#46 recorded it

root.description: The accordion: its border and rounded corners.

button.description: The button that opens and closes a section, holding its title.

padding.x.$description: Accordion button left and right padding.

body.description: A section's content, shown while it's open.

padding.x.$description: Accordion body left and right padding, lined up with the button's.
